set.prevailing_wage_basis: Labor Code 1720(b)(4) treats fees waived or reduced by a political subdivision as payment out of public funds, but 1720(c)(3) excludes de minimis subsidies (under $600,000 and under 2% of total project cost), so coverage depends on project size and other public funds; the San Leandro resolution states no prevailing wage requirement. https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720
